ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
tl: Izaa zul zilatil ardu zil zaalaha
Yawma iziy yas durun naasu ash tatal liyuraw a'maalahum
Famaiy ya'mal mithqala zarratin khai raiy-yarah
en: When the earth is shaken with its quake.
And the earth brings out its loads.
And man says, “What is the matter with it?”
On that Day, it will tell its tales.
For your Lord will have inspired it.
On that Day, the people will emerge in droves, to be shown their works.
Whoever has done an atom's weight of good will see it.
And whoever has done an atom's weight of evil will see it.
sw: Itakapo tetemeshwa ardhi kwa mtetemeko wake!
Na itakapo toa ardhi mizigo yake!
Kwa sababu Mola wake Mlezi ameifunulia!
Siku hiyo watu watatoka kwa mfarakano wakaonyweshwe vitendo vyao!
Basi anaye tenda chembe ya wema, atauona!
Na anaye tenda chembe ya uovu atauona!
fr: Quand la terre tremblera d'un violent tremblement,
et que la terre fera sortir ses fardeaux,
ce jour-là, elle contera son histoire,
selon ce que ton Seigneur lui aura révélé [ordonné].
Ce jour-là, les gens sortiront séparément pour que leur soient montrées leurs œuvres.
Quiconque fait un bien fût-ce du poids d'un atome, le verra,
et quiconque fait un mal fût-ce du poids d'un atome, le verra.
